Hi Lena / Tom 

Great to meet earlier  thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

1) Goal: Validate that Redwood reduces inference cost by >= 35% at 95th percentile latency <= 200ms for your triage inference workload (approx. 1k qps peak during tests).
2) Success criteria (proposed):
   - Throughput: sustained 900+ qps on a 4-GPU Dedicated pool for the 1-minute load window
   - P95 latency <= 200ms (end-to-end, app -> Redwood -> model)
   - Cost: >= 35% improvement vs current baseline (tokenized metric we agreed on)
   - Functional: parity on accuracy for the named-entity extraction prompts (testset v1) with <= 1% regression

3) Proposed POC plan (high level):
   - Prep (week of July 27): test dataset + keys, infra baseline capture, integration validation
   - Trial (Aug 3-14): 10 business days of traffic-injection tests + steady-state runs
   - Final readout (week of Aug 17): exec-facing 30-minute review + delivery of results and contract conversation

4) Ownership:
   - Aurora: Lena (product lead)  test acceptance & evaluation signoff; Priya (infra)  test orchestration
   - Redwood: Rishi (AE)  program lead; Marissa (CS)  POC execution & ops; Marcus (Solutions)  model/latency tuning

I've attached a short POC plan and a success-criteria spreadsheet. Please review and tell us: 1) any missing eval metrics, 2) confirm ownership, and 3) preferred readout week (we proposed Aug 17 week).

Next steps I can take immediately: finalize test dataset access, schedule a short kickoff with Priya to walk infra, and lock the readout invite once you confirm.

Thanks 
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0191
